deals_unit_price_pair.name: deals_unit_price_pair
deals_unit_price_pair.value: ("deals"."unit" IS NULL AND "deals"."unit_price" IS NULL) OR ("deals"."unit" IS NOT NULL AND "deals"."unit_price" > 0)

purchase_items_expense_subcategory_needs.name: purchase_items_expense_subcategory_needs_category
purchase_items_expense_subcategory_needs.value: "purchase_items"."expense_subcategory" IS NULL OR "purchase_items"."expense_category" IS NOT NULL

recurring_payment_occurrences_status.name: recurring_payment_occurrences_status
recurring_payment_occurrences_status.value: ("recurring_payment_occurrences"."status" = 'paid' AND "recurring_payment_occurrences"."expense_id" IS NOT NULL) OR ("recurring_payment_occurrences"."status" = 'skipped' AND "recurring_payment_occurrences"."expense_id" IS NULL)
